note: The script asks for four graphics: the HOPE IS… hook text, name plates for Paul Chavez and Cheryl Little (names only: Paul's title is too long for the tag and Cheryl's title is in her gala film, not this script) and the AIJ IN ONE WORD section text. Row 00:27–00:36 asks for WHERE HOPE MEETS THE LAW, but the blueprint marks that row as part of the end card, so it is not made.

mg.title: Hope is hook
mg.cue: Text on frame 1: HOPE IS… Big, white, Filson Pro Heavy. Cut on, no fade.
mg.use: The script wants it cut on with no fade. Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:02.

mg.title: Paul Chavez plate
mg.cue: Name plate at first sight, lower left, 2 s, small: Paul Chavez
mg.use: Put it on the first frame Paul is on screen and hold it 2 seconds. Move it lower left and keep it small.

mg.title: Cheryl Little plate
mg.cue: Name plate, lower left, 2 s: Cheryl Little
mg.use: Put it on when Cheryl appears at 00:13 and hold it 2 seconds. Move it lower left and keep it small.

mg.title: AIJ in one word
mg.cue: Section text, top: AIJ IN ONE WORD. On screen 2 s.
mg.use: Section text at the top for 2 seconds as this row starts. AIJ wants its name in full on screen, so check this line with Nick before you use it.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: Tagline before the logo: “WHERE HOPE MEETS THE LAW”. Then Horizontal Animated logo. Logo here only.
mg.src: AIJ's own Vertical Animated logo (Mobile Video).mp4 from the AIJ Outros/Intros pack (Drive), the newest outro AIJ has given us.
mg.use: This is the end card, the client's own file. Put it at 00:36 after the last line and use it exactly as it is. The tagline WHERE HOPE MEETS LAW is part of AIJ's own animation.
